mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knockout_round (stage_id, round_no, name, sort_order) VALUES (#{stageId}, #{roundNo}, #{name}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knockout_round WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY sort_order, round_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knockout_tie (stage_id, round_id, bracket_position, home_team_id, away_team_id, winner_team_id, next_tie_id, next_slot, is_third_place, status) VALUES (#{stageId}, #{roundId}, #{bracketPosition}, #{homeTeamId}, #{awayTeamId}, #{winnerTeamId}, #{nextTieId}, #{nextSlot}, #{thirdPlace}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE knockout_tie SET home_team_id = #{homeTeamId}, away_team_id = #{awayTeamId}, winner_team_id = #{winnerTeamId}, next_tie_id = #{nextTieId}, next_slot = #{nextSlot}, is_third_place = #{thirdPlace}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knockout_tie WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY round_id, bracket_position

SELECT t.* FROM knockout_tie t JOIN knockout_round r ON r.id = t.round_id WHERE t.stage_id = #{stageId} AND r.round_no = (SELECT MIN(round_no) FROM knockout_round WHERE stage_id = #{stageId}) ORDER BY t.bracket_position
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knockout_seed (stage_id, source_group_id, source_rank, target_tie_id, target_slot) VALUES (#{stageId}, #{sourceGroupId}, #{sourceRank}, #{targetTieId}, #{targetSlot})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knockout_seed WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY source_group_id, source_rank
